segments.text: I was literally just thinking about you and the juicy fat Andy listen. I need a huge favor
Can you pick me up from Jason's whoa? What what is it? Are you okay? I'm fine. I just need her right to the hospital
Fucking asshole. I knew it. Just stay there. I'm coming over right now. No, no, don't come yet. I'll call you
No, no, no come now. I won't take that long
Trust trust trust. I wouldn't even be that long
